who_it_serves: Fairfax County residents (and City of Fairfax residents for emergency shelter referrals) facing a housing emergency or unable to pay rent.
cost: Free
requirements: Former ERA-BP 4.0 criteria (for reference): Fairfax County resident with valid lease living in the unit; rent at or below 150% of Fair Market Rent; gross household income at or below 80% AMI ($74,800 for 1 person to $141,000 for 8). Documents: proof of income (pay stubs, bank statements, employer letter, pension records), valid lease or proof of landlord-tenant relationship, landlord rent ledger and W-9; court-involvement verification and hardship documentation may be required.
how_to_apply:
1. Call Coordinated Services Planning at 703-222-0880 (TTY 711), Monday-Friday, 8 a.m.-4:30 p.m.

Staff offer case management toward housing.
